title: Hybrid Sparse-Dense Fusion: Visual Guide
outline: Title: Hybrid Sparse-Dense Fusion: Visual Guide

1. Two Retrievers, One Funnel | the bridge from the recall/precision funnel: the same funnel with two sources at the mouth, plus a slider for how independently BM25 (recall@100 0.85) and dense (0.82) fail, moving the fused union from 0.850 to 0.973 | the second retriever's value is failure independence, not average quality — and the union is a hard ceiling on everything the reranker can do

2. Three Query Autopsies | toggle BM25-only / dense-only / hybrid over the three worked queries (error 0x80070057, dizzy when standing up, treatments that do not involve surgery), tap any query for the per-system post-mortem | sparse and dense fail on different queries, so hybrid answers 2 of 3 where each alone answers 1 — but fusion cannot repair the negation query both sides fail

3. The RRF Ledger | steppers move each document's rank in the BM25 and dense lists (defaults A 1/6, B 2/2, C 5/absent, D absent/1) and a slider moves k from 1 to 200, recomputing sum of 1/(k+rank) and re-sorting live | consensus across two lists beats one system's top hit (B wins at k=60 with 0.0323 vs A's 0.0315); small k makes position dominate, large k flattens into a vote count, and k=60 is deliberately insensitive

4. Normalize Or Rank | five documents with raw BM25 and cosine scores under min-max, z-score or RRF; drag the top BM25 score from 9.0 to 25.0 and the alpha weight, with the score-fused order and the RRF order shown side by side | min-max is hostage to one outlier (it crushes d2-d5 into the bottom ~12% of the range) and both normalizations are per-query, while rank fusion is invariant to any monotone score transform and never moves

5. The Atrium Path | the request path with real milliseconds (BM25 15 ms and ANN 20 ms in parallel = 25 ms wall, RRF+dedupe+ACL 6 ms, cross-encoder 0.7 ms per pair, p95 ~80 ms at depth 50) plus a rerank-depth slider and the two designed degraded modes | every component covers a specific weakness of the others, pair throughput = query rate x rerank depth, and the fallbacks (BM25-only with a logged flag, serve the fused order) are evaluated configurations rather than accidents
